notes: Use the host LAN address reachable from the target device, not Docker's internal API port.
Exposed-mode release claims require HTTPS; local/VPN smoke may use local HTTP.

common_steps.title: Verify Docker deployment health
common_steps.expected_evidence: Screenshot or log line showing /health/ready success from the target network.

common_steps.title: Select server origin on :48027
common_steps.expected_evidence: Client shows the selected Duskcue server origin without exposing bearer tokens.

common_steps.title: Authenticate through device-linking or platform login
common_steps.expected_evidence: Authenticated home/library view appears; failed attempts produce Problem Details mapping.

common_steps.title: Browse libraries, media rows, and a media detail page
common_steps.expected_evidence: At least one library row and one media detail page render with placeholder/artwork fallback behavior.

common_steps.title: Start playback from a resumable media item
common_steps.expected_evidence: Playback starts; stream decision, first-frame time, and selected device profile are recorded.

common_steps.title: Seek/resume, emit heartbeat, then stop playback
common_steps.expected_evidence: Server watch state updates and subsequent resume starts at the expected position.

common_steps.title: Switch audio and subtitle tracks
common_steps.expected_evidence: Supported track change succeeds; unsupported track maps to the expected error fixture.

common_steps.title: Export diagnostics bundle or equivalent platform evidence
common_steps.expected_evidence: Bundle/log evidence contains request IDs and omits tokens, signed URLs, private paths, and raw watch history.

common_steps.title: Logout and clear local session state
common_steps.expected_evidence: Auth credential is removed from secure storage and protected routes require re-auth.

setup: Install debug APK or run Flutter on device/emulator.
Allow local-network cleartext only for local/VPN smoke.
extra_steps: Rotate between portrait and landscape during playback.
Confirm Android notification/media controls do not leak media URLs.

setup: Run from Xcode or TestFlight.
Use a LAN-reachable :48027 origin and approve local-network prompt if shown.
extra_steps: Toggle VoiceOver or Dynamic Type for one browse/playback path.
Background and foreground the app during playback where supported.

setup: Install or run the Tauri desktop build.
Confirm selected server origin points at :48027.
extra_steps: Use keyboard-only navigation for setup, browse, and playback.
Validate OS-keyring token removal after logout.

setup: Run signed development or local Tauri app.
Use current macOS stable release or documented supported baseline.
extra_steps: Validate Keychain token storage.
Check local-network prompt behavior when connecting to LAN Docker host.

setup: Run packaged Tauri build on the target distro.
Confirm WebKitGTK runtime and secret-service availability.
extra_steps: Smoke both Wayland and X11 when both are claimed.
Document credential fallback if keyring is unavailable.

setup: Install on Android TV emulator and at least one Google TV device.
Use D-pad remote input only after setup.
extra_steps: Validate TV surface/deep-link revalidation.
Check playback with HLS transcode and direct-compatible media.

setup: Connect through ADB and install the debug build.
Use the Fire TV remote for all TV smoke after setup.
extra_steps: Validate Fire OS-specific back/menu behavior.
Check memory/storage pressure on stick-class hardware.

setup: Sideload the Roku channel package on a physical Roku device.
Pair with a Docker host reachable at :48027.
extra_steps: Run deep-link and Direct to Play smoke cases.
Validate unsupported subtitle fallback behavior.

setup: Run in Samsung TV Emulator and on at least one physical or Remote Test Lab TV before release.
Use Tizen certificate profile for device install.
extra_steps: Validate AVPlay HLS startup/seek/resume.
Check Return/Back and Smart Hub launch return behavior.

setup: Run in webOS TV Emulator and on a Developer Mode physical TV before release.
Install IPK through webOS CLI or Studio.
extra_steps: Smoke Magic Remote pointer and D-pad focus paths.
Validate HLS playback and launch/relaunch parameters.

setup: Run on tvOS simulator and at least one Apple TV 4K physical device before release.
Use TestFlight or Xcode deploy for hardware evidence.
extra_steps: Validate Siri Remote focus and play/pause behavior.
Smoke Top Shelf/Universal Link launch revalidation when implemented.

setup: Run the UWP shell on Windows first, then deploy to Xbox through Device Portal when hardware is available.
Use controller-only navigation for console smoke.
extra_steps: Validate MediaPlayerElement startup/seek/resume.
Check system media transport controls and URI activation when implemented.
